BETA Close X CRH plc announced that on March 26, 2026, it purchased 116,334 of its ordinary shares in the United States through its broker, Wells Fargo Securities, LLC, as part of its share buyback program. The total volume-weighted average price paid across all transactions was $104.3749 per share, with the highest price paid being $106.27 and the lowest $103.36. These repurchased shares will be cancelled, and following these transactions, CRH plc will have 668,591,860 ordinary shares in issue, with 35,643,874 shares held in treasury, representing 5.061% of the issued ordinary share capital. Disclaimer* 27 th March 2026 CRH plc Transaction in Own Shares CRH plc (“ CRH ”) announces that on 26 th March 2026 it acquired the following number of its ordinary shares (the “ ordinary shares ”) in the United States through CRH’s broker Wells Fargo Securities, LLC. The ordinary shares acquired (by way of redemption) will be cancelled. CRH will also hold 35,643,874 of its ordinary shares in treasury, which represents 5.061% of the issued ordinary share capital of CRH. Ordinary shares held in treasury do not have any voting rights.
